manifest.selection: Right optic-lobe patch: axial radius 4 around published hex (19,20); 20 declared visual types; upstream R1–R6 into L1/L2/L3; at most 61 unhexed cells per declared type selected by total incoming contacts from the patch. Unhexed positions inferred from strongest patch partner.
manifest.exclusions: All cells and connections outside the patch are excluded. Boundary inputs are not reconstructed.
manifest.dynamics: Modeled signed leaky-rate network; neurotransmitter-to-sign mapping is an approximation, not receptor physiology.
manifest.input_mapping: Raycast luminance to inferred R1–R6 hex coordinates via strongest measured L1/2/3 partner. Not calibrated fly vision.
manifest.output_mapping: Trainable artificial two-action readout; not biological motor-neuron semantics.
